1.  Recommendation to approve appointments to the Recreation and Parks Commission.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, presented the staff report.

  Mayor Pro Tem De Paula spoke.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Del Rio, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to approve
  recommendation.

2.  Recommendation to approve and authorize the City Manager to enter into the Commercial Lease
  Agreement between the City of Hawaiian Gardens and the Family Health Care Centers of Greater
  Los Angeles, Inc. for the continued operation of a heath care clinic located at 22310 Wardham
  Ave.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, presented the staff report.

  Councilmember Vargas spoke.

  Mayor Pro Tem De Paula spoke.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, spoke.

  Councilmember Roa spoke.

  A discussion ensued between the Mayor, Councilmembers, City Manager, Recreation Director,
  and City Attorney.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Del Rio, seconded by Mayor Farfan, to approve
  recommendation, with a waiver of lease payments for four months, while the transition takes place.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Del Rio, Roa, Vargas, De Paula, Farfan

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, corrected the rate for the YEP Program mentioned at the previous
meeting.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that the Annual National Night Out event will be held on
August 6, 2024.

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, thanked everyone in the community for
coming out to the fireworks show and car show.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, provided an update on completed projects and the
Carson Beautification, Phase 2 project starting next month.

Sacramento discussing AB549.
